# R6.37 — E2-T4(b): observation plumbing — durable model-view renderings of armed exec observations (manifest 295)

Harness: devin-cli / swe-2-high / subagent — engineered (offline, $0.00)

Offline-only, zero-spend ticket wiring R6.36's typed `ResultRenderSpec`
machinery into the live armed-exec observation path (G18, spec §7.3;
REQ-XE-109; ADR-0440 D2). Before this row the model-facing `tool` message
was the observation payload's canonical JSON (or
`{"kind":"no_observation_recorded"}`); now an armed surface's declared
renderer produces the model view from the raw output, the rendered bytes
land as a durable blob, and the `context.observation.recorded` row records
their content address before the request that carries them (X-04).
Replay/resume re-serves the recorded bytes — never a re-render.

## Design choice (the ticket's two-leg option)

Sibling mint inside `dispatch_at` (hh-env): the rendered bytes are the
kernel's own observation product, so they are produced and recorded in the
same fenced batch as `action.effect.{observed,completed}` — one
`context.observation.recorded` row per observation (contract-admitted and
contract-less armed paths share the class; `admission`/`label` stay
absent-not-null where `admit` never ran). No new event class (CC10).

## What landed

- **`DispatchInput.result_renderer: Option<&ResultRenderer>`** — `None` ⇒
  the pre-change pipeline, byte-identical (the opt-in rule). `dispatch_at`
  renders via `hharness_compiler::result_render::render` (the one pure
  home — CC1, never a second implementation) over the kernel's own record
  `{output, returncode?, exception_info?}` — `output` is the masked raw
  output, byte-identical to the `raw_output_ref` blob by construction.
  On success the rendered string is `put_blob`bed (`text/plain`) and the
  row carries `model_view{ref, renderer}`; a spec the record cannot serve
  mints `model_view{outcome:"render_refused", reason}` — honest refusal
  with member/class ids only, never fabricated bytes (a post-`committed`
  refusal rides the observation plane, the `leaf_refused` channel).
- **`events.rs`** — `observation_recorded_payload` now takes
  `Option<&Admission>` (absent-not-null where `admit` never ran) +
  `model_view: Option<&Json>`; `observation_refused_payload` gains
  `model_view` identically.
- **hh-embed** — `DispatchGate.result_renderers` (surface_id → renderer)
  populated at `service.rs::drive` from the armed `ModelSurface`'s
  `tools[].result_render.renderer`; `dispatch_exec` joins by the intent's
  surface id. An unarmed session's map is empty — every dispatch runs the
  legacy path.
- **`gateway_model.rs`** — `transport` is a `Box<dyn Transport>`
  (production `HttpModelTransport`; `with_transport` is the offline
  fixture seam for R6.12's `RecordedTransport`). `transcript()` — a
  joined row carrying `model_view.ref` serves the recorded blob's bytes
  verbatim as the `tool` message content (`Json::str`); an unresolvable
  ref is `MalformedHistory` (the `response_ref` rule). Rows without
  `model_view` keep the pre-change payload-as-content behavior — the
  `no_observation_recorded` fallback is unchanged.

## Verification (offline, $0.00)

- `cargo test -p hharness-embed --test r6_37` — **3/3**:
  - AC-1/2: armed `text_head_tail@1` (threshold 10) — 16-char output
    renders head+marker+tail, 5-char renders whole; `GatewayModel` over
    `RecordedTransport` (mc.1's recorded `tool_calls` answer decodes
    through the family's own translators); both `tool` message contents
    equal `render(renderer, {output, returncode:0})`; the durable blob
    bytes equal the render verbatim; each `context.observation.recorded`
    seq precedes mc.2's `model.call.requested`/`model.call.completed`
    (`model_io` boundary).
  - AC-3: drop + real `Store` reopen after the recording; the resumed
    `requested_members` re-serves byte-identical `tool` content from the
    recorded address; a drifted renderer (`threshold 1`) armed on resume
    does not change the serve (asserted `!=` the drifted render).
  - AC-4: unarmed (empty map) and renderer-less (`result_render` with no
    `renderer`) dispatch mint **zero** `context.observation.recorded`
    rows — the transcript renders the pre-change
    `{"kind":"no_observation_recorded"}` byte-identical;
    `classes.rs` registers exactly one `context.observation.recorded`.
- `cargo test -p hharness-embed -p hharness-env` — all suites green
  (incl. r6_34 6/6, r6_35 4/4+9/9, r6_36 6/6, r5_8, kill_point_battery).
- `cargo fmt --all --check` — clean.
- `check-supplement-guard.sh` — **PASS · DISPATCH — R6.37** (pre);
  post-run below.
- No `spec/` edits, no generated files touched, no new deps
  (`cargo tree` unchanged — hh-env already depends on hh-compiler).
- Goldens `provenance: hand_derived` (REQ-XE-114); `RecordedTransport`
  evidence is replay-served, never a live-service claim.

## Deviations / notes

- The ticket offered "mint inside `dispatch_at`" as a permitted choice —
  taken (single row per observation; the batch lands the blob-ref before
  `completed`, and the model fence deposits `model_io` after — the
  ordering is by construction, AC-2 pins it).
- `model_view` rides the refused leg (`observation_refused_payload`)
  too — an armed renderer + leaf refusal still records the rendering
  (absent-not-null both ways).
- AC-3's kill is modelled as drop + real store reopen (the durable
  batch is the kill boundary; R6.8 conventions), the same fence the
  driver's own kill-point battery exercises.
- DF-R6.23-1 remains OPEN (archive_verified gate citations for later
  R6.4x rows — not this row's scope).
